CREATE.TITLE: New template
CREATE.NAME_HINT: Lowercase letters, numbers and underscores only.
CREATE.HEADER_MEDIA_NOTE: Upload a sample file (Meta requires it to approve the template). JPG/PNG image, MP4 video or PDF document.
CREATE.INVALID_VARS: Meta rejects these variable names: {vars}. Use only lowercase letters, numbers and underscore (no spaces or capitals), e.g. {'{'}{'{'}company_name{'}'}{'}'} or {'{'}{'{'}1{'}'}{'}'}.
CREATE.EDGE_VAR: The body can't start or end with a variable (Meta rejects it). Add fixed text before and after, e.g. "Hi {'{'}{'{'}name{'}'}{'}'}, welcome".
CREATE.CONSECUTIVE_VARS: Two variables can't be next to each other with no text between them.
CREATE.MIXED_VAR_TYPES: You can't mix positional ({'{'}{'{'}1{'}'}{'}'}) and named ({'{'}{'{'}name{'}'}{'}'}) variables in the same body.
CREATE.VALIDATION_ERRORS_TITLE: Fix these issues before sending to Meta:
CREATE.HEADER_LOCATION_NOTE: No sample content is required now — latitude, longitude, name and address are filled in when the template message is actually sent.

KIND.LABEL: Template type
KIND.AUTH_AUTO_NOTE: Authentication is a separate form: Meta generates the body/footer text automatically from the settings below.
KIND.STANDARD_HINT: Message with text, image, video or document and buttons.
KIND.CAROUSEL_HINT: Up to 10 swipeable cards, each with its own image and buttons.
KIND.STANDARD_DESC: The classic template: a text message with an optional image, video or document on top and buttons below. Good for alerts, confirmations and promotions.
KIND.CAROUSEL_DESC: One message with several cards the contact swipes through. Each card has its own image or video, text and up to two buttons. Ideal to show several products or offers at once.
KIND.FLOW_DESC: A message with a button that opens a form inside WhatsApp: the contact answers screen by screen without leaving the chat. You build the form right here and answers arrive structured in Jabvox.

AUTH.NOTE: Meta generates the body and footer text automatically — no header, free-form body or footer, markdown, emojis or URLs are allowed for this category.
AUTH.SECURITY_RECOMMENDATION: Add security recommendation ("For your security, do not share this code")

LTO.LABEL: Limited-time offer (adds an expiration date when the message is sent)

CAROUSEL.NOTE: Add between 2 and 10 cards. Each card has its own image/video and up to 2 buttons (QUICK_REPLY/URL/PHONE_NUMBER).
CAROUSEL.MEDIA_REQUIRED: This card still needs its file.
CAROUSEL.NOT_UPLOADED: The file was not uploaded to Meta. Check the setup and try again.

CREATE.VARS_EMPTY: No variables detected yet. Add numbered placeholders in the body to create variables.
CREATE.PREVIEW_NOTE: Review exactly how your template will look in WhatsApp before submitting to Meta.
CREATE.SUBMIT_NOTE: This action will submit the template to Meta for review keeping all current approval workflows.
CREATE.SUBMIT_HINT: Ensure variable examples and buttons are valid before submission.
CREATE.NO_INBOXES: No WhatsApp Cloud inboxes configured in this account.

FLOW.NEEDS_TERMINAL: Mark the last screen as final so the form can be submitted.
FLOW.CATEGORY_HELP: Tells Meta what the form is for. It does not change what the contact sees.
FLOW.MISSING_NEXT: the button does not say which screen it opens
FLOW.SELECT_WIDGET: Pick an element from the screen to configure it.
FLOW.BUTTON_LOCKED_NOTE: This template opens a form, so Meta only allows this button. You can change its label.
FLOW.EMPTY_SCREEN: This screen has no content yet.
FLOW.SCREEN_NAME_HELP: Shown at the top of the screen inside WhatsApp.

CREATE.VARS_HELP: Meta reviews the template using these values, so use realistic examples of what will be sent.
